Hi team,

Our WhatsApp booking automation stopped working this morning. Patients are calling the clinic because appointment confirmations are not going out, and two doctors' calendars are double-booked. This is the workflow you built for us and it is affecting today's patients right now.

Please treat this as top priority and tell us today itself what is happening and by when it will be fixed.

Priya Sharma
SmileCare Dental Clinic
subject: URGENT: Patient booking automation is down - appointments failing since morning

body:
Hello Forethinq Labs,

I run a small real estate agency (6 agents). We get enquiries from property portals and our team is slow to follow up - sometimes a day late. I saw your lead triage demo and wondered if something similar could work for our inbox: sort new enquiries, flag the serious buyers, and maybe draft the first reply for us.

Could you share how much something like this would cost and how long it takes to set up? Happy to get on a short call next week if that helps.

Thanks,
Daniel
subject: Enquiry: automating our lead follow-up emails
